Runbook: restart a single service hosted in a shared svchost

1. Find the process that hosts the service:

   tasklist /svc /fi "SERVICES eq Spooler"

   The Services column lists every service in that process, for
   example "RpcEptMapper, RpcSs". Continued lists wrap under the
   column.

2. If the process hosts only that service, end it with taskkill /PID.
   Otherwise restart the service with sc stop and sc start.
